environment_setting: Suburban neighborhood in Country B, where property crimes have been on the rise, and residents are increasingly concerned about protecting their belongings.
norm_base: Property Possessors Using reasonable force to protect property Not criminally responsible if force is reasonable

legitimate.legitimate_action: Installing security cameras and motion-sensor lights around his property
legitimate.benefits: Deters potential thieves, ensures property safety without confrontation
legitimate.costs: Initial investment in security equipment, time spent on installation

illegal.illegal_action: Using excessive force to confront a suspected thief on his property
illegal.benefits: Immediate protection of property, emotional satisfaction of confronting the thief
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences if force is deemed unreasonable, risk of physical harm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Organizing a neighborhood watch program to prevent property crimes
legitimate.benefits: Improves community safety, builds trust among neighbors
legitimate.costs: Time and effort required to organize and participate in the program

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging neighbors to take vigilante actions against suspected criminals
illegal.benefits: Immediate sense of control over neighborhood safety
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences for inciting unlawful behavior, risk of escalating violence

legitimate.legitimate_action: Locking his tools in a secure shed and installing an alarm system
legitimate.benefits: Prevents theft without confrontation, ensures safety of his equipment
legitimate.costs: Cost of purchasing and maintaining the alarm system

illegal.illegal_action: Setting up booby traps around his property to harm intruders
illegal.benefits: Deters potential thieves, emotional satisfaction of taking extreme measures
illegal.costs: Legal consequences if traps cause harm, risk of injuring innocent individuals
